title: Уксус в фирменный рулет  (Vinegar in the Signature Roll)

segments.t: Left alone to place Barani's signature meat roll into the oven, Chef Barinov decides to take his revenge on his former pupil by dousing the dish with sour vinegar. Meanwhile outside in the courtyard, Senya and Fedya try to rig a prank on Barani's convertible.
